system.longDesc:
Cost: 5 SP

One of the crew can temporarily bring a damaged weapon, or a weapon that has run out of ammo, (possibly the result of the GM using a Churn Effect) back online. A character can attempt a TN 14 Intelligence (Engineering) or Accuracy (Gunnery) test to bring a weapon back online. The weapon can make 1d3 shots before giving up the ghost for good and requiring a proper repair. The weapon cannot be brought back online again without the ship receiving full maintenance at a spaceport.
